title: Ultrasound Physics, Instrumentation and SPI Preparation
description:
Outcome: Students should understand the physical principles behind ultrasound image formation, recognise artefacts, optimise images and prepare for the Sonography Principles and Instrumentation (SPI) examination.

The SPI component should follow the current examination blueprint of the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography. SPI preparation alone does not establish eligibility for the examination or confer a professional credential.

title: Echocardiography and Cardiac Ultrasound
description: This module should be treated as introductory unless students receive dedicated cardiac training and supervised clinical practice.

title: Ultrasound-Guided Interventions
description:
This should be a dedicated module because image-guided procedures require additional knowledge of anatomy, needle visualisation, asepsis, complications and procedural safety.

Important: This module should teach the principles, indications, preparation, imaging and safety considerations for interventions. Actual invasive procedures must be performed only by appropriately qualified and authorised practitioners under suitable supervision. A sonography education programme does not independently authorise a student to perform biopsies, drainage, injections or other invasive procedures.
